Adjacent span[data-as=p] elements convert like paragraphs

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use HtmlToMarkdown\HtmlToMarkdown;
$result = HtmlToMarkdown::convert("<div><span data-as=\"p\">First paragraph.</span><span data-as=\"p\">Second paragraph.</span></div>");
var_dump($result->content);
```
